newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: International banks group welcomes Wallis report.
newsitem.headline: International banks group welcomes Wallis report.

text.p: The International Banks and Securities Association of Australia (IBSA) said on Wednesday the Wallis inquiry into the financial sector was an "excellent framework" for the future development of the sector.
The association, which represents investment banks, said many of the recommendations would lead to a more competitive and less regulated sector if adopted.
IBSA executive director Robert Webster said the government should establish a financial sector advisory council ahead of industry consultation on implementing the report.
